candidates.title: Draft a national exam room schedule

demandEvidence.chore: Plan and coordinate national exams, prepare exam schedules, and book rooms.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Planera, administrera och samordna nationella prov Upprätta provscheman och boka lokaler

ease.reason: A spreadsheet prototype can draft exam time and room slots from fictional availability; the notice gives no software or setup support.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school might value schedule preparation; this paid staff vacancy does not establish demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can draft a schedule from operator-supplied fictional exams and room slots; no attached reference supports implementation.

autonomy.reason: A draft can flag collisions from supplied slots, but staff must confirm exam constraints and make all bookings.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice explicitly requests exam planning, schedules and room bookings, but gives no frequency, constraints or software evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a bounded fictional-data schedule-drafting experiment. Five modest ratings average 4.6, below threshold; no attached building reference supports the proposed mechanics, and real constraints/access need review.

rejected.title: Draft a national exam room schedule
rejected.reason: Assessed a bounded fictional-data schedule-drafting experiment. Five modest ratings average 4.6, below threshold; no attached building reference supports the proposed mechanics, and real constraints/access need review.

rejected.title: School systems administration
rejected.reason: The fresh notice only says to handle school administrative systems and processes; it gives no concrete task to scope without inventing duties.

rejected.title: Coordinate school administration
rejected.reason: The notice describes parallel responsibilities and flexibility but names no concrete chore or bounded output; do not infer duties from the role.

rejected.title: Broad school and student administration
rejected.reason: The notice lists broad staff and student administration and proactive support without a specific repeated task, so a useful narrow experiment cannot be grounded.

steps.message: Assessed all four enriched education demand leads. One supports a concrete exam scheduling chore, but the fictional-data prototype has a modest mean of 4.6 and no attached implementation reference; the other notices lack bounded task evidence. No post proposed.
